conflicts.permit: We will not sell the personal information of consumers we actually know are less than 16 years of age, unless we receive affirmative authorization (the “right to opt-in”) from either the consumer who is at least 13 but not yet 16 years of age, or the parent or guardian of a consumer less than 13 years of age;
conflicts.prohibit: We do not knowingly collect any Personal Information from any person who is under the age of 16 or allow them to register an account.
conflicts.situation: A user under 16 years of age interacts with the service or provides consent/opt-in for the sale of their personal information.
conflicts.reason: The policy strictly bars collecting personal info from anyone under 16, yet explicitly contemplates obtaining opt-in authorization to sell personal info from consumers under 16.
